label: The sustaining sibling of esse dependence, from contact and co-presence
description: Transcription (single application, invariant 16): the last step applies the co-presence bridge, whose consequent is the conclusion; the only typed work is the contact step from giving to presence. Let c, distinct from x, cause x's esse and give x being at every moment at which x is present, in every history. For any history v and moment t with x present, c gives x being at t, so c is present at t (contact c4661518): the typed step from giving to presence is the work done here. Hence c is present whenever x is, in every history, and the co-presence bridge gives that x depends for its being on c. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation: the bridge (Control part 2, dependence empty) and contact (part 3, an absent giver); both hold with the conclusion nonvacuously (part 4). Both premises stay OPEN; the bridge carries the untyped history-coverage condition. No premise is established.
